FOURTH AMENDMENT
to Contract for Security Guards Services
by and between
ZIMS Security (Private) Limited (the "First Party") and Zameen Media (Private) Limited
(the "Second Party")
[Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]
This fourth (4th) amendment (the "Fourth Amendment") to the Contract for Security Guards
Services dated 14th December, 2020 further amended through First Amendment dated 15th
February, 2021, Second Amendment dated 131h December, 2021 and Third Amendment dated
May, 2022 (collectively referred to as the "Contract") is made and entered into at Lahore on
29th
this
March, 2024.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Contract for security services to be provided by First Party to
make available Security Staff at the Locations specified by the Second Party on such
terms and conditions as agreed in writing between the Parties from time to time; and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Contract as per the terms and
conditions of this Fourth Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The Fourth Amendment shall come into force on 1st April, 2024.

2.

The Term of the Contract is hereby further extended for a period of two (2) years
commencing from 1st April, 2024 and ending on 315t March, 2026 ("Term").

3.

From 1St April, 2024, the rates for security services agreed between the Parties are as
follows:
Sr#

4.

This Fourth Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Contract.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Contract shall mutatis mutandis apply and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event

of any conflict, the terms of this Fourth Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Contract shall bear the same meaning in
this Fourth Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7.

This Fourth Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together
shall constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this Fourth Amendment, having fully
understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
